subject: Quick delivery label question
text:
The drop-off is still on for noon, but I need a tiny huddle before the van gets loaded. Last night I looked at the list again and the line about leftovers at the corner table has me scratching my head. Do they mean the table by the window, the one near the coffee urn, or the side table where the volunteers keep their jackets? The note just said grab everything marked with a blue tag, so I bagged the jars and boxes on that surface, but I left the tall crates stacked under it. If those crates are part of the delivery, we should move them before the truck backs in.

I can swing by thirty minutes early if we need to check labels together. No rush to answer, just ping me before the morning meeting so we don't double-load or miss a whole batch. I'm good to drive, and my back is finally not screaming, so we're all set except for the mystery table. If the crates stay, I can stack them in the shed and label them for the next run. Let me know if the driver mentioned a different gate too.
